# ctables/print

> Print: writes an `int`, `u8`, `bool` or `str` and a newline to stdout.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/print.pkg) · translates [std/print](../std/print.md)

  Each print is one or two `write` calls, unbuffered, like bintables.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when value str`

```nasm
__pk_print_str(
{value}
);
```

### `emit when value bool`

```nasm
__pk_print_bool(
{value}
);
```

### `emit`

```nasm
__pk_print_int(
{value}
);
```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
static void __pk_print_int(W v) {
char buf[24];
char *p = buf + sizeof buf;
uint64_t u = v < 0 ? -(uint64_t)v : (uint64_t)v;
*--p = '\n';
do { *--p = (char)('0' + u % 10); u /= 10; } while (u);
if (v < 0) *--p = '-';
write(1, p, buf + sizeof buf - p);
}
static void __pk_print_str(W s) {
write(1, (char *)s + 8, *(W *)s);
write(1, "\n", 1);
}
static void __pk_print_bool(W b) {
if (b) write(1, "true\n", 5); else write(1, "false\n", 6);
}
```
